loadout_strategy.philosophy: Blue Crab Island is a multi-class lake with saltwater (Tarpon, Snook, Permit, Bonefish, Drum), brackish (Bass varieties), and freshwater (Bowfin, Bullhead, Catfish). Current 7-rod loadout was experimental  -  testing if UncleSam 6'3" Heavy and LibertyCast 8'10" Med-Light could fill mid-light gaps. Result: BOTH rods underperformed and wore down both reels significantly. Brutus + SharpCaster + bottom rods carried the day.
validated_winners: Brutus 10'10" SE Match (Slot 1) + CGT SpinTitan 4500 + Trophy Mono .02" + Float + Hook #6/0 + Shiners  -  "perfect for this location" per user; right balance for medium-weight fish
SharpCaster 7'3" (Slot 3) + VorteX 7000 SE + Club-Series Glow&Holo Medium Spoon 1 Oz #4/0  -  covers full lure-weight spectrum, ideal day + night spoon work
NileChasseur 6'3" SE (Slot 4) + GiantSpin 9000 SE + Three-way + Offset Hook #6/0 + Ribbed Shad 6"  -  Congo MVP rig transferred well; landed Unique Common Snook 35.843 lb

Mokonzi 12'10" SE (Slot 6) + L'impulsion 12000 SE + Sinker 6 Oz + Titanium Leader .018" + Hook #6/0 + Large Cutbait  -  produced significantly; landed Unique Black Drum 82.786 lb + Unique Red Drum 66.827 lb
Tribal Totem 12'10" (Slot 7) + Savanna Spirit 11000 + Sinker 5 1/2 Oz + Titanium Leader .018" + Hook #6/0 + Shiners  -  bottom workhorse
validated_losers: UncleSam 6'3" Spinning (Slot 2) Heavy  -  reel speed wrong, didn't match lure/jig sizes, insufficient line strength for medium-big fish. Wore down Patriot's Dream 4000 reel to 27,226/46,200 (59%) durability
LibertyCast 8'10" Casting (Slot 5) Med Light  -  too light for the larger fish encountered. Wore down AmericanEagle 2000 reel to 9,242/46,200 (20% RED  -  needs repair)

trip_2_findings_4_26.permit_hotspot: Southern inlet from Gulf  -  3-hour real-time hunt across multiple spots before finding this single productive zone
trip_2_findings_4_26.time_of_day_finding: Bite frequency PEAKS in afternoon  -  start trips at 12 PM not 5 AM. Counter to typical FP dawn-fishing wisdom.

loadout_validation.sharpcaster_mvp: SharpCaster 7'3" + VorteX 7000 SE = MVP for trophy fish at BCI
loadout_validation.dragoncast_underpowered: DragonCast 7'3" NE confirmed underpowered for BCI deeper water  -  broke lines + tackle even with VorteX 7000 SE upgrade. The rod blank is the limit, not the reel. KEEP DragonCast for shallow bass-only locations (Falcon/Neherrin/Emerald/White Moose).

line_weight_experiment.tested: 23 Lb to 40 Lb across mono, braid, fluorocarbon
line_weight_experiment.hit_rate_finding: No significant difference across line weights at BCI's fish class
line_weight_experiment.fluoro_finding: Fluorocarbon flexed significantly more than mono/braid, made retrieves much harder in deeper water
line_weight_experiment.recommendation: Use mono or braid 25-40 Lb on active rods at BCI; reserve fluoro for leader sections only

trip_2_findings_4_26.perimeter_mapping: Used bottom rods + marker buoys to map productive boat-fishing perimeters in southern bay. Tested bait + hook size combinations to identify species-specific producers.
trip_2_findings_4_26.cost_vs_congo: BCI = ~half Congo's XP and income, but ~half the cost. No Spine Stringer needed (FishStronghold M Plus 308.6 lb single-fish cap is sufficient  -  no 300+ lb fish landed here).
trip_2_findings_4_26.saltwater_bait_preference: Saltwater baits (Sand Fleas, Muscle Meat, Finger Mullets) significantly outperform freshwater baits at BCI. Freshwater works but slower bite rate. First-saltwater-location lesson  -  applies to future Florida Keys / saltwater DLC trips.

buzzbait_technique_correction.technique: Drop-and-pause mid-water/bottom: cast → bottom → bounce off bottom → raise a few seconds → drop → bounce again. NOT a topwater technique despite real-world buzzbait association.
buzzbait_technique_correction.hookset: Pause LONGER than usual before setting  -  fast hookset snaps the lure out of the fish's mouth. Wait for clear weight commitment.
buzzbait_technique_correction.why_misses_happen: Setting hook too quickly is the most common cause of missed buzzbait strikes  -  not retrieve speed or reel ratio.

overall_analysis.first_trip_verdict: EXCEPTIONAL  -  cleared Expedition I, nearly cleared Expedition II, filled keepnet, multiple Uniques. Worth returning regularly for both XP grinding and saltwater species variety. Ranks among the best new-location debuts of the week.
overall_analysis.fit_with_current_loadout: MIXED  -  5 of 7 slots fit perfectly (Brutus, SharpCaster, NileChasseur, Mokonzi, Tribal Totem). 2 slots (UncleSam + LibertyCast) underperformed and wore down both reels significantly. Pre-trip experimentation with rod-class spread didn't pay off here  -  the experimentation hypothesis was wrong for BCI's fish class spread.
overall_analysis.session_potential: HIGH  -  single trip yielded 4 Uniques + 9 Trophies + 68 fish. Repeatable with refined loadout (replacing Slot 2 + Slot 5).

comparison_to_other_locations.vs_saint_croix: BCI offers similar volume (60-70 fish keepnet) but with bigger trophy ceiling (Tarpon 154 lb >> Blue Cat 80 lb) and saltwater variety. Saint-Croix easier to grind; BCI more interesting for diversity.
comparison_to_other_locations.vs_dnipro: Both Level ~50 European/American mid-tier. Dnipro has Wels 132 lb max single; BCI has Tarpon 154 lb max. BCI has wider species variety (24 vs 32  -  Dnipro wins on count, BCI wins on per-species value).
comparison_to_other_locations.vs_congo: BCI is the income/volume play; Congo is the trophy/XP play. Different roles in the rotation.
